exposure: Indications for amniocentesis (e.g., high risk in prenatal screening tests, abnormal ultrasonographic findings)
cohort: 120 patients from Van and its surrounding provinces who underwent amniocentesis between 2018 and 2020.
finding: Fetuses with abnormal ultrasound screening had a higher rate of chromosomal anomaly diagnosed by amniocentesis, with 11.6% of all fetuses showing a chromosomal anomaly, predominantly Trisomy 21.
